tagline.en_US: Run the Manticore search engine with its HTTP and MySQL-compatible interfaces and persistent local data.

description.en_US: Manticore Search is an open-source database designed specifically for search and stream filtering. It provides full-text, vector, and hybrid search capabilities with multi-threaded execution across both row-wise and columnar storage. Users can interact with the engine using standard SQL through MySQL-compatible clients or via an HTTP JSON interface.
